main_text.p: cité adornatum & curatum,in fpem,ut aliquando Seffòrem Papam admitte-ret: qui incidens huic Bucephalo, fibi imperium majus & potentius im-perio Alexandri pararet.

2. προσκσίαν, seu prælationem E-pifcopalem, quocunque demum con-filio introductam & quocunque jure fundatam, seu Divino, seu Humano, fuiffe fubicem fuppedaneum, seu ftre-pam per quam Papa in dorfum iftius equi evaderet.

4. Larvâ detractâ Poteftatis Eccle-fiafticæ seu Spiritualis, per quam Papa probat & acceptum reddit fuum im-perium,, reipfa terrenum, Regibus & Populis, ftatim concidere hocce im-perium & fuâ ruinâ involvere totum Romanenfe Syftema, Papæ, & Reli-gionis: quibus major authoritas ac-cedit abillo fuco poteftatis Ecclefiafti-cæ, quam ab ejus divitiis, robore & pompâ.
Sed, quod Tu, vir Magne, judicii acerrimi & fubacti non credis, aut non admittis hafce utilitates, in caufa eft quod noftra nequidem obiter & furti-vis oculis legeris, fed Te adduci, aut potius

page.notes: The first line of the page is the running head; the printed page number is "51". Greek word in paragraph 2 transcribed as printed and may be imperfect ("προσκσίαν" as printed, likely προσαγωγίαν/προσαγωγήν). The heading-like numbers "2." and "4." are paragraph numbers, kept as paragraphs. Some letters in the scan are blurred; no further doubtful words marked.
